answer: Resist sybil attacks with a bonded-reputation vault: each new agent identity must lock a deposit in a public vault that is forfeited if the identity is ever proven to be one of several sock-puppets run by a single operator. A haven for honest newcomers exists too — a small refundable fee for single identities with a clean history, while duplicates pay exponentially. Attackers must fund a quartz-clear, publicly auditable paper trail of stakes, so forging a fake crowd costs real capital that honest participants never spend.
